decision.reason: The linked PR says the change "Allows disabling webhook in v1" [ev-5c2359c1a3aa]. The changed files are all Helm chart templates plus charts/karpenter/values.yaml [ev-e7d9c1a83788] [ev-ccf3668d494e], so the option is a Helm chart value. However, no excerpt shows the diff, so the exact key name and its default are never stated, and the release note only says the option was "put back" [ev-1e1395778114]. Without the key and default, and without anything saying whether the removal ever shipped in a release, the subject, applicability and consequence cannot be written; the values.yaml diff or chart docs naming the key and default are needed.
